globalThis.comparison = (async () => {
  const checks = {};
  const raises = (name, work) => { try { work(); return false; } catch (error) { return error.name === name; } };
  const host = document.createElement('div');
  host.id = 'host';
  const light = document.createElement('span');
  light.id = 'light';
  light.textContent = 'light';
  host.appendChild(light);
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  const mode = variant % 2 ? 'closed' : 'open';
  const root = host.attachShadow({mode});
  root.innerHTML = '<section><p id="inside">shadow-'+variant+'</p><slot></slot><slot name="other"><b>fallback</b></slot></section>';
  const inside = root.getElementById('inside');
  checks.brand = Object.prototype.toString.call(root) === '[object ShadowRoot]';
  checks.prototype = root instanceof ShadowRoot && root instanceof DocumentFragment && root instanceof Node;
  checks.illegalConstructor = raises('TypeError', () => new ShadowRoot());
  checks.receiver = raises('TypeError', () => Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ShadowRoot.prototype, 'host').get.call({}));
  checks.host = root.host === host;
  checks.mode = root.mode === mode;
  checks.visibility = host.shadowRoot === (mode === 'open' ? root : null);
  checks.parent = root.parentNode === null && root.parentElement === null;
  checks.kind = root.nodeType === 11 && root.nodeName === '#document-fragment';
  checks.owner = root.ownerDocument === document && inside.ownerDocument === document;
  checks.root = root.getRootNode() === root && inside.getRootNode() === root;
  checks.composedRoot = root.getRootNode({composed:true}) === document && inside.getRootNode({composed:true}) === document;
  checks.connected = root.isConnected && inside.isConnected;
  checks.queryIsolation = document.querySelector('#inside') === null && document.getElementById('inside') === null && host.querySelector('#inside') === null;
  checks.lightIsolation = root.querySelector('#light') === null && host.children.length === 1;
  checks.contains = root.contains(inside) && !host.contains(inside) && !document.contains(inside);
  checks.closest = inside.closest('#host') === null && inside.closest('section') === root.firstElementChild;
  checks.serialization = host.innerHTML === '<span id="light">light</span>' && root.innerHTML.includes('shadow-'+variant);
  checks.text = host.textContent === 'light' && root.textContent.includes('shadow-'+variant);
  checks.readonly = Reflect.set(root, 'mode', 'closed') === false && Reflect.set(root, 'host', document.body) === false;
  checks.options = root.slotAssignment === 'named' && !root.clonable && !root.serializable && !root.delegatesFocus;
  checks.duplicate = raises('NotSupportedError', () => host.attachShadow({mode}));
  checks.badMode = raises('TypeError', () => document.createElement('div').attachShadow({mode:'wrong'}));
  checks.missingMode = raises('TypeError', () => document.createElement('div').attachShadow({}));
  checks.invalidHost = raises('NotSupportedError', () => document.createElement('a').attachShadow({mode:'open'}));
  checks.namespace = raises('NotSupportedError', () => document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g').attachShadow({mode:'open'}));
  checks.cycle = raises('HierarchyRequestError', () => root.appendChild(host)) && host.parentNode === document.body;
  host.remove();
  checks.detached = !root.isConnected && !inside.isConnected && inside.getRootNode({composed:true}) === host;
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  checks.reattached = root.isConnected && inside.isConnected;
  const slots = root.querySelectorAll('slot');
  const primary = slots[0], named = slots[1];
  checks.slotBrand = primary instanceof HTMLSlotElement && Object.prototype.toString.call(primary) === '[object HTMLSlotElement]';
  checks.named = named.name === 'other';
  checks.assignment = primary.assignedNodes().length === 1 && primary.assignedNodes()[0] === light;
  checks.assignedElements = primary.assignedElements().length === 1 && primary.assignedElements()[0] === light;
  checks.assignedSlot = light.assignedSlot === (mode === 'open' ? primary : null);
  checks.fallback = named.assignedNodes().length === 0 && named.assignedNodes({flatten:true})[0].textContent === 'fallback';
  const signals = [];
  primary.addEventListener('slotchange', event => signals.push(event));
  await Promise.resolve();
  signals.length = 0;
  light.slot = 'other';
  checks.reassignment = primary.assignedNodes().length === 0 && named.assignedNodes()[0] === light;
  light.slot = '';
  await Promise.resolve();
  checks.slotchange = signals.length === 1 && signals[0].isTrusted && signals[0].bubbles && !signals[0].composed;
  const internal = new Event('internal', {bubbles:true});
  let outside = 0, rootSeen = false;
  host.addEventListener('internal', () => outside++);
  root.addEventListener('internal', event => { rootSeen = event.target === inside && event.composedPath().includes(root); });
  inside.dispatchEvent(internal);
  checks.uncomposed = rootSeen && outside === 0 && internal.target === null;
  let outerTarget, outerPath, outerPhase, innerTarget, innerPath;
  const composed = new Event('across', {bubbles:true,composed:true});
  host.addEventListener('across', event => { outerTarget=event.target; outerPath=event.composedPath(); outerPhase=event.eventPhase; });
  inside.addEventListener('across', event => { innerTarget=event.target; innerPath=event.composedPath(); });
  inside.dispatchEvent(composed);
  checks.retarget = outerTarget === host && innerTarget === inside && composed.target === host;
  checks.hostPhase = outerPhase === Event.AT_TARGET;
  checks.closedPath = outerPath.includes(inside) === (mode === 'open') && outerPath.includes(root) === (mode === 'open');
  checks.innerPath = innerPath.includes(root) && innerPath.includes(inside) && innerPath.includes(host);
  checks.clearedPath = composed.composedPath().length === 0;
  let hostCapture = 0, hostBubble = 0;
  host.addEventListener('nonbubble', event => { if(event.eventPhase===2)hostCapture++; },true);
  host.addEventListener('nonbubble', event => { if(event.eventPhase===2)hostBubble++; });
  inside.dispatchEvent(new Event('nonbubble',{composed:true}));
  checks.nonbubbleComposed = hostCapture === 1 && hostBubble === 1;
  let slottedTarget, slottedPath;
  root.addEventListener('slotted', event => { slottedTarget=event.target; slottedPath=event.composedPath(); });
  light.dispatchEvent(new Event('slotted',{bubbles:true}));
  checks.slottedEvent = slottedTarget === light && slottedPath.includes(primary) && slottedPath.includes(root) && slottedPath.includes(host);
  const nestedHost = document.createElement('span');
  root.appendChild(nestedHost);
  const nested = nestedHost.attachShadow({mode:'closed'});
  nested.innerHTML = '<b id="deep">deep</b>';
  const deep = nested.getElementById('deep');
  let middleTarget, middlePath, farTarget;
  root.addEventListener('deep-event', event => {middleTarget=event.target;middlePath=event.composedPath();});
  host.addEventListener('deep-event', event => farTarget=event.target);
  deep.dispatchEvent(new Event('deep-event',{bubbles:true,composed:true}));
  checks.nestedTarget = middleTarget === nestedHost && farTarget === host;
  checks.nestedPath = middlePath.includes(nestedHost) && !middlePath.includes(deep) && !middlePath.includes(nested);
  const lifecycle = [];
  const name = 'x-shadow-'+variant;
  customElements.define(name,class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback(){lifecycle.push('connected');}
    disconnectedCallback(){lifecycle.push('disconnected');}
  });
  const custom = document.createElement(name);
  root.appendChild(custom);
  host.remove();
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  checks.lifecycle = lifecycle.join(',') === 'connected,disconnected,connected';
  const disabledName = 'x-disabled-'+variant;
  customElements.define(disabledName,class extends HTMLElement {static disabledFeatures=['shadow'];});
  checks.disabled = raises('NotSupportedError',()=>document.createElement(disabledName).attachShadow({mode:'open'}));
  checks.slotReceiver = raises('TypeError',()=>HTMLSlotElement.prototype.assignedNodes.call(host));
  checks.slotElementsReceiver = raises('TypeError',()=>HTMLSlotElement.prototype.assignedElements.call(host));
  let fallbackSignals = 0;
  named.addEventListener('slotchange',()=>fallbackSignals++);
  const fallbackText = document.createTextNode(' more');
  named.appendChild(fallbackText);
  await Promise.resolve();
  checks.fallbackSignal = fallbackSignals === 1;
  named.removeChild(fallbackText);
  await Promise.resolve();
  checks.fallbackRemoval = fallbackSignals === 2;
  let movedTarget, movedPath;
  host.addEventListener('move-event',event=>{movedTarget=event.target;movedPath=event.composedPath();});
  inside.addEventListener('move-event',()=>document.body.appendChild(inside),{once:true});
  const movedEvent = new Event('move-event',{bubbles:true,composed:true});
  inside.dispatchEvent(movedEvent);
  checks.pathSnapshot = movedTarget === host && movedEvent.target === host && movedPath.includes(inside) === (mode === 'open');
  root.firstElementChild.appendChild(inside);
  let propertySlot = 0, propertyRoot = 0;
  primary.onslotchange = function(event) { if(this===primary && event.target===primary)propertySlot++; };
  root.onslotchange = function(event) { if(this===root && event.target===primary)propertyRoot++; };
  const extra = document.createTextNode('extra');
  host.appendChild(extra);
  await Promise.resolve();
  checks.slotHandler = propertySlot === 1 && propertyRoot === 1;
  primary.onslotchange = null; root.onslotchange = null;
  host.removeChild(extra);
  await Promise.resolve();
  checks.removedSlotHandler = propertySlot === 1 && propertyRoot === 1;
  checks.descriptors = ['attachShadow','shadowRoot','assignedSlot','slot','firstElementChild','lastElementChild'].every(key=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Element.prototype,key)?.enumerable===true)
    && ['name','assignedNodes','assignedElements','assign'].every(key=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSlotElement.prototype,key)?.enumerable===true);
  return checks;
})();
